narr: Widespread strong-to-severe thunderstorms developed along a quasi-stationary boundary across central and southern Oklahoma and western-north Texas during the evening of the 30th. In addition to a measured severe-caliber wind gust, the combination of high moisture content in the lower atmosphere and slow-moving thunderstorms led to a few localized areas of flash flooding across southern Oklahoma.
ev: A section of Main Street was closed due to flooding in the community of Ada. The location and event time are approximate.
Roadway flooding along Lee Boulevard due to water rise from nearby Numu Creek. Several cars became stranded in floodwaters at this location. The event time is approximate.
lsr: Multiple cars stranded in floodwaters along Lee Boulevard. Emergency management relayed the report.
